
=== WebPanel: Produccion.listarExtrusoraProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Extrusora Producto'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ExtrusoraNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraProductoCalibre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraProductoAncho.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraProductoLongitud.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraNombre'
					&TFExtrusoraNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoNombre'
					&TFProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraProductoCalibre'
					&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraProductoAncho'
					&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraProductoLongitud'
					&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo'
					&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso'
					&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarExtrusoraProducto.Link(TrnMode.Display, ExtrusoraProductoId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarExtrusoraProducto.Link(GeneXus.TrnMode.Update, ExtrusoraProductoId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarExtrusoraProducto.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusoraProductoId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarExtrusoraProducto.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &ExtrusoraProductoId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.ExtrusoraProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	&Insert_ExtrusoraId.SetEmpty()
	&Insert_ProductoId.SetEmpty()
	
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusoraId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusoraId"
					&Insert_ExtrusoraId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ProductoId"
					&Insert_ProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWExtrusoraProducto()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ExtrusoraProductoId);

ExtrusoraProductoId = &ExtrusoraProductoId if not &ExtrusoraProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraProductoId);
noprompt(ExtrusoraProductoId);

ExtrusoraId = &Insert_ExtrusoraId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
ProductoId = &Insert_ProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoId.IsEmpty();}
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarExtrusoraProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&ProductoCategoriaNombre = ObtenerConfiguracion.Udp(!'CategoriaBobina')
	&AuditTableName = !'ExtrusoraProducto'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoraproducto_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoraproducto_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoraproducto_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&ExtrusoraProducto.Load(&ExtrusoraProductoId)
			&LoadSuccess = &ExtrusoraProducto.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &ExtrusoraProducto.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraId.Enabled = False
				Combo_ExtrusoraProducto_ProductoId.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraProductoCalibre.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraProductoAncho.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraProductoLongitud.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	Do 'LoadComboExtrusoraProducto_ProductoId'
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	ExtrusoraProducto_ExtrusoraProductoId.Visible = False
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &ExtrusoraProductoId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Combo_ExtrusoraProducto_ProductoId.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ExtrusoraProducto.ProductoId.FromString(Combo_ExtrusoraProducto_ProductoId.SelectedValue_get)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> GeneXus.TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&ExtrusoraProducto.Delete()
			Else
				&ExtrusoraProducto.Save()
			EndIf
			If &ExtrusoraProducto.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &ExtrusoraProducto.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&ExtrusoraProductoId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarExtrusoraProductoExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Nombre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Nombre")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Calibre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Calibre")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Ancho")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Ancho")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Longitud")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Longitud")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Reposo (min)")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Proceso (min)")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		order ExtrusoraProductoId  when &OrderedBy = 1
		order ExtrusoraNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoCalibre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoCalibre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoAncho  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoAncho)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoLongitud  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoLongitud)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ExtrusoraNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraProductoCalibre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ExtrusoraProductoCalibre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraProductoAncho'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ExtrusoraProductoAncho)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraProductoLongitud'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ExtrusoraProductoLongitud)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraNombre", '', !'Extrusora', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoNombre", '', !'Producto Nombre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraProductoCalibre", '', !'Producto Calibre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraProductoAncho", '', !'Producto Ancho', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraProductoLongitud", '', !'Producto Longitud', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo", '', !'Reposo (min)', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso", '', !'Proceso (min)', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOCALIBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOCALIBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOANCHO"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOANCHO_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOLONGITUD"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOLONGITUD_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOTIEMPOREPOSO"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAPRODUCTOTIEMPOPROCESO"
				&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarextrusoraproducto_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Extrusora Producto List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFExtrusoraNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoAncho
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoLongitud
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
		&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Reposo (min)", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso
		&TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Proceso (min)", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		order ExtrusoraProductoId  when &OrderedBy = 1
		order ExtrusoraNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoCalibre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoCalibre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoAncho  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoAncho)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoLongitud  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoLongitud)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSORANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusoraNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadProductoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSORAPRODUCTOCALIBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusoraProductoCalibreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSORAPRODUCTOANCHO'
		Do 'LoadExtrusoraProductoAnchoOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSORAPRODUCTOLONGITUD'
		Do 'LoadExtrusoraProductoLongitudOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.

		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarExtrusoraProductoGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)

Sub 'LoadExtrusoraNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusoraNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		Order ExtrusoraId
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
			Order ExtrusoraId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusoraNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadProductoNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductoNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductoNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		Order ProductoId
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
			Order ProductoId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ProductoNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadExtrusoraProductoCalibreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		Order ExtrusoraProductoCalibre
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
			Order ExtrusoraProductoCalibre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusoraProductoCalibre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusoraProductoCalibre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadExtrusoraProductoAnchoOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		Order ExtrusoraProductoAncho
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
			Order ExtrusoraProductoAncho
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusoraProductoAncho.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusoraProductoAncho
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadExtrusoraProductoLongitudOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		Order WWPBaseObjects.ExtrusoraProductoLongitud
		using listarExtrusoraProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoCalibre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho, &TFExtrusoraProductoAncho_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud, &TFExtrusoraProductoLongitud_Sel, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
					, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo_To, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso, &TFExtrusoraProductoTiempoProceso_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
			Order ExtrusoraProductoLongitud
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusoraProductoLongitud.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusoraProductoLongitud
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&DDOName, in:&SearchTxt, in:&SearchTxtTo, out:&OptionsJson, out:&OptionsDescJson, out:&OptionIndexesJson);

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.ViewExtrusoraProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where ExtrusoraProductoId = &ExtrusoraProductoId
		Form.Caption = ExtrusoraProductoId.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWExtrusoraProducto.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusoraProductoId, in:&TabCode);


=== WebPanel: DB.WWExtrusoraProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Extrusora Productoes'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()

--- Refresh (Event) ---
Grid.SaveSessionState()

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&Update.Link = ExtrusoraProducto.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusoraProductoId)
	&Delete.Link = ExtrusoraProducto.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusoraProductoId)
	ExtrusoraProductoId.Link = ViewExtrusoraProducto.Link(ExtrusoraProductoId, "")
	ProductoNombre.Link = ViewProducto.Link(ProductoId, "")
	ExtrusoraNombre.Link = ViewExtrusora.Link(ExtrusoraId, "")

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
ExtrusoraProducto(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ExtrusoraProductoId))


=== DataProvider: Produccion.DPCBProducto ===

--- Source (Source) ---

DVB_SDTComboData
Where ProductoCategoriaId = &ProductoCategoriaId when Not &ProductoCategoriaId.IsEmpty()
Where ProductoCategoriaNombre = &ProductoCategoriaNombre when Not &ProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty()
{
	Item
	{
		ID = Notifications.ProductoId.ToString()
		Title = ProductoClave
	}
}

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(&ProductoCategoriaId, &ProductoCategoriaNombre);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerConfiguracion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
FOR EACH DB.Configuracion
	WHERE ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
	&ConfiguracionValor = ConfiguracionValor
	EXIT
WHEN NONE
	new 
		ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		ConfiguracionValor = ''
	endnew
	commit
ENDFOR

--- Rules (Rules) ---
PARM(IN:&ConfiguracionKey, OUT:&ConfiguracionValor);

=== Transaction: DB.Configuracion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWConfiguracion()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ConfiguracionKey);

DB.ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey if not &ConfiguracionKey.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ConfiguracionKey) if not &ConfiguracionKey.IsEmpty();
noprompt(ConfiguracionKey);
}
